meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会多出两个工具：列出 Atomic Chat 中的本地模型，把提示词发给选定的模型并拿回回答。Claude 仍负责整体任务，但可以把部分环节交给本地模型处理。
howto.when: 当用户要求把 Atomic Chat 接入项目、让 agent 能调用本地模型，或说“用 Atomic Chat 回答”时，该技能会运行并完成代码修改与注册。

say.text: 帮我把 Atomic Chat 的 MCP 工具加进 NanoClaw 项目。
say.note: 会先检查是否已安装，再做配置。

say.text: 添加 Atomic Chat 集成，让 agent 能调用本地模型。
say.note: 将复制文件并注册 MCP 服务器。

say.text: 给代理装上 Atomic Chat 的两个工具，用于列模型和生成回答。
say.note: 完成后 Claude 就能调用本地模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains two tools: one lists local models in Atomic Chat, the other sends prompts to a selected model and returns its answer. Claude stays the main controller but can hand off parts of the job to these local models.
howto.when_en: Runs when the user asks to integrate Atomic Chat into the project so the agent can call local models, or says to answer using Atomic Chat; it then applies code changes and registers the MCP server.

say_en.text: Add the Atomic Chat MCP tool to the NanoClaw project.
say_en.note: Checks prerequisites, copies files, and registers the server.

say_en.text: Add Atomic Chat integration so the agent can call local models.
say_en.note: Edits the runner config and forwards environment variables.

say_en.text: Install two Atomic Chat tools for listing models and generating replies.
say_en.note: After this, Claude can use those two MCP tools.
